action_summary: Restore the strongest documented preprocessing: 512-pixel images and standard ImageNet normalization. Preserve horizontal-flip probability averaging and add a conservative full-frame scale ensemble weighted 80% at 512 and 20% at 640, retaining most of the historically stronger scale while adding resolution diversity. This blend is an unvalidated hypothesis; the historical normalization recovery is the main evidence-backed improvement. Keep the supplied checkpoint, model architecture and Kaggle paths; use smaller sequential inference batches, remove unused version-sensitive imports, require complete checkpoint loading, cache scale predictions, and export unscaled probabilities in sample-submission order. No training, inference, external data access or internet use was performed.
